articles.title: Download Update
articles.summary: Downloads the new Shokker version. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > banner under the title bar (update available).

controls.label: Download Update
controls.effect: Downloads the new Shokker version

pitfalls: Save your project first; installing restarts the app.

combos.why: Works together with the Remind Me Later control.

articles.title: Remind Me Later
articles.summary: Hides the update banner for now. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > banner under the title bar (update available).

controls.label: Remind Me Later
controls.effect: Hides the update banner for now

combos.why: Works together with the Download Update control.

articles.title: IRACING USER ID box
articles.summary: Your iRacing customer number (4-7 digits); it is part of the saved file names. It is a text box.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > top row > iRacing User ID. Your iRacing Customer ID (4-7 digits): in iRacing click the helmet icon (top right), then Profile. Hint inside the box: Customer ID.
when: First setup; paint does not show in iRacing.

controls.label: IRACING USER ID box
controls.effect: Your iRacing customer number (4-7 digits); it is part of the saved file names

pitfalls: A wrong ID means iRacing ignores the files.

combos.why: Works together with the IRACING CAR FOLDER box control.

articles.title: CUSTOM NUMBER
articles.summary: Custom Number: the number is part of your paint and iRacing will not add one. It is an on/off switch.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > top row > iRacing User ID. Starts as on.
how: Click to switch it on or off.

controls.label: CUSTOM NUMBER
controls.effect: Custom Number: the number is part of your paint and iRacing will not add one

pitfalls: Needs Settings > Graphics > Hide Car Numbers ON in iRacing to load car_num_.

combos.why: Works together with the SIM-STAMPED NUMBER control.

articles.title: SIM-STAMPED NUMBER
articles.summary: Sim-Stamped Number: iRacing stamps your number on the car in the series font. It is an on/off switch.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > top row > iRacing User ID.
when: You want iRacing to place the number.
how: Click to switch it on or off.

controls.label: SIM-STAMPED NUMBER
controls.effect: Sim-Stamped Number: iRacing stamps your number on the car in the series font

pitfalls: Do not also paint a number on the template.

combos.why: Works together with the CUSTOM NUMBER control.

articles.title: SOURCE PAINT box
articles.summary: The paint file Shokker works on (a flat TGA / PNG / JPEG, or a PSD): type or paste a path, or use the buttons beside it. It is a text box.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > top of the window (header rows). Source Paint - disk TGA path, imported/derived source path, or live layered canvas source. Hint inside the box: Drop/paste a source path, browse TGA, or import PSD.
when: Start of every job; "I loaded my paint and nothing happened".

controls.label: SOURCE PAINT box
controls.effect: The paint file Shokker works on (a flat TGA / PNG / JPEG, or a PSD): type or...

pitfalls: Pasting a folder path here does not load a paint. A flat TGA has no layers; a PSD does.

combos.why: Works together with the TGA/PNG/JPEG control.
Works together with the PSD/XCF/ORA control.
Works together with the Import PSD control.

articles.title: TGA/PNG/JPEG
articles.summary: Browse for a flat paint picture (TGA / PNG / JPEG / BMP) and load it as the paint. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > top of the window (header rows).
when: You have a single flat paint file.

controls.label: TGA/PNG/JPEG
controls.effect: Browse for a flat paint picture (TGA / PNG / JPEG / BMP) and load it as the...

pitfalls: Dropping an image on the canvas also REPLACES the paint; it does not add a logo (use + Layer for that).

combos.why: Works together with the SOURCE PAINT box control.
Works together with the PSD/XCF/ORA control.

articles.title: PSD/XCF/ORA
articles.summary: Browse for a layered PSD / XCF / ORA template so every layer (body, numbers, sponsors, tape) stays separate. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > top of the window (header rows). Import a layered PSD, XCF, or ORA file with its editable layer tree.
when: You want layer-level control: numbers only, sponsors only.

controls.label: PSD/XCF/ORA
controls.effect: Browse for a layered PSD / XCF / ORA template so every layer (body, numbers...

pitfalls: Make sure the template layers (Mask, Wire, Car_Mandatory) are OFF before exporting.

combos.why: Works together with the Import PSD control.
Works together with the Open Layered control.

articles.title: IRACING CAR FOLDER box
articles.summary: The iRacing car folder the finished paint and spec files are written to. It is a text box.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > top of the window (header rows). iRacing Car Folder - point to the exact car paint folder, not a TGA file. Hint inside the box: e.g.
when: Paint is not showing in iRacing, or choosing which car.

controls.label: IRACING CAR FOLDER box
controls.effect: The iRacing car folder the finished paint and spec files are written to

pitfalls: Point to the car FOLDER, not a TGA file. It sets the file names car_num_ID.tga or car_ID.tga and car_spec_ID.tga.

combos.why: Works together with the Pick detected iRacing car control.
Works together with the IRACING USER ID box control.

articles.title: Pick detected iRacing car
articles.summary: Pick your car from the list of iRacing cars Shokker detected (most recently painted first). It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > top of the window (header rows). Pick from your detected iRacing cars (most recently painted first).
when: Faster than browsing for the folder.

controls.label: Pick detected iRacing car
controls.effect: Pick your car from the list of iRacing cars Shokker detected (most recently...

pitfalls: If your car is missing, paint it once in iRacing or browse for the folder.

combos.why: Works together with the IRACING CAR FOLDER box control.

articles.title: Browse iRacing car folder in Windows File...
articles.summary: Browse for the iRacing car folder in Windows. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > top of the window (header rows).

controls.label: Browse iRacing car folder in Windows File...
controls.effect: Browse for the iRacing car folder in Windows

aliases: browse iracing car folder in windows file

combos.why: Works together with the IRACING CAR FOLDER box control.
Works together with the Pick detected iRacing car control.
